k01-pos1.label: violation
k01-pos1.note: BillingService imports the Rental aggregate from the rentals context internals.

k01-pos2.label: violation
k01-pos2.note: CatalogService imports the rentals application port RentalRepository directly.

k01-twin1.label: clean
k01-twin1.note: Billing builds the charge from the RentalReturned contract imported via the rentals index.

k01-twin2.label: clean
k01-twin2.note: Catalog declares its own local port for open rental counts and imports nothing new from rentals.

k01-legit.label: clean
k01-legit.note: Billing imports RentalService as a type through the rentals public index and only reads.

k02-pos1.label: violation
k02-pos1.note: Charge aggregate imports the infrastructure FakePaymentGateway and calls it.

k02-pos2.label: violation
k02-pos2.note: Equipment aggregate imports the express Request HTTP type.

k02-twin1.label: clean
k02-twin1.note: Payment collection is orchestrated in the application service; Charge stays infrastructure-free.

k02-twin2.label: clean
k02-twin2.note: Equipment is built from a plain data object, not an HTTP request type.

k02-legit.label: clean
k02-legit.note: Domain code computes a rate using the shared-kernel Money type.

k03-pos1.label: violation
k03-pos1.note: giveBackBoth loads and saves two Rental instances in one command.

k03-pos2.label: violation
k03-pos2.note: retireAndReplace saves the retired and the replacement Equipment in one command.

k03-twin1.label: clean
k03-twin1.note: giveBackBoth delegates to the single-save giveBack command twice; no command saves two aggregates directly.

k03-twin2.label: clean
k03-twin2.note: retireAndReplace delegates to the single-save retire and register commands.

k03-legit.label: clean
k03-legit.note: giveBackAndFlag saves one Rental and publishes a flag event for later handling.

k04-pos1.label: violation
k04-pos1.note: RentalRepository.saveBoth persists two Rental aggregates in one call.

k04-pos2.label: violation
k04-pos2.note: EquipmentRepository.replace persists the retired and the replacement Equipment together.

k04-twin1.label: clean
k04-twin1.note: RentalRepository gains a read query; persistence stays one aggregate per save.

k04-twin2.label: clean
k04-twin2.note: EquipmentRepository gains a lookup by serial; save still persists one aggregate.

k04-legit.label: clean
k04-legit.note: The repository saves one Rental together with its inner Extension rows.

k05-pos1.label: violation
k05-pos1.note: RentalService.open synchronously marks the catalog's Equipment as rented through the ACL.

k05-pos2.label: violation
k05-pos2.note: BillingService.settleEarly calls the rentals giveBack write command directly.

k05-twin1.label: clean
k05-twin1.note: Cancelling a rental publishes RentalCancelled; the catalog frees the equipment in its own handler.

k05-twin2.label: clean
k05-twin2.note: Billing publishes EarlySettlementRequested; the rentals context closes its own rental in a handler.

k05-legit.label: clean
k05-legit.note: Extending a rental publishes RentalExtended; the catalog updates its own Equipment in a handler.

k06-pos1.label: violation
k06-pos1.note: Composition root facade opens a rental and then marks the catalog equipment as rented.

k06-pos2.label: violation
k06-pos2.note: Composition root facade gives back a rental and settles the billing charge in one function.

k06-twin1.label: clean
k06-twin1.note: Facade startRental only delegates to the rentals command; reactions happen through events.

k06-twin2.label: clean
k06-twin2.note: Facade closeRental only delegates to the rentals giveBack command.

k06-legit.label: clean
k06-legit.note: main.ts only wires dependencies and subscriptions, extracted into a helper.

k07-pos1.label: violation
k07-pos1.note: refund calls the payment gateway inside the transaction callback.

k07-pos2.label: violation
k07-pos2.note: onRentalReturned sends a receipt through the gateway inside the transaction callback.

k07-twin1.label: clean
k07-twin1.note: refund calls the gateway first and opens the transaction only to persist the result.

k07-twin2.label: clean
k07-twin2.note: settleAll captures payments outside any transaction and persists inside short transactions.

k07-legit.label: clean
k07-legit.note: The receipt is sent only after the transaction has committed.

k08-pos1.label: violation
k08-pos1.note: The 30-day maximum for opening a rental is checked in the service and dropped from the aggregate.

k08-pos2.label: violation
k08-pos2.note: The extension total-days limit is checked in the service and dropped from Rental.extend.

k08-twin1.label: clean
k08-twin1.note: The overdue rule lives in Rental; the service only delegates.

k08-twin2.label: clean
k08-twin2.note: The non-blank name rule lives in Equipment.rename; the service only delegates.

k08-legit.label: clean
k08-legit.note: The service validates only input format (non-blank id, whole number) before delegating to the aggregate.
